$comment: Generated by bootstrap.sh from a project at @@SOURCE_ROOT@@. Edit freely.

limits.$comment: Context budget. profile 'default' = historical caps, compaction off. profile 'small' = preset for ~32k-context models: tighter caps on every injected blob plus history compaction (once a request reports prompt_tokens >= compact_threshold_tokens, older tool results are shrunk in place to compact_result_chars; the last compact_keep_groups rounds stay verbatim). Any explicit key here overrides the profile. Tune compact_threshold_tokens to your window (leave headroom for the reply).

classifier.$comment: Parallel pre-classifier (run.sh --classifier). A cheap model pre-decides DOCUMENT vs SKIP for upcoming commits so the full agent only runs for DOCUMENT ones. model is required to use the mode. base_url/api_key_env left empty inherit the llm section (same provider and key); set them to use a different provider. workers = parallel classification requests; queue = how many DOCUMENT verdicts may wait ahead of the main loop (small = little lost work on interrupt). Mutually exclusive with --reuse-verdicts.

validation.$comment: post-write docs validation. mode: strict = remaining errors flip the verdict to ERROR (commit retried); warn = report only; off. rounds: how many repair rounds the agent gets before the final verdict. path_check: severity of the 'cited repo path must exist in the worktree' check.
